image_description: A close-up photograph of an adult guenon monkey holding a juvenile. The adult has olive-brown fur with a lighter underbelly and a distinctive facial ruff. The face is bare with dark skin, forward-facing eyes, and a narrow nose. The adult's arm wraps around the infant, whose head rests against the adult's chest. The infant has similar but fluffier fur and large, expressive eyes. A long tail is partially visible in the background.

Eyes are clearly forward-facing. Irises appear dark brown/black, consistent with the species description.
The nasal structure is narrow and prominent, characteristic of Old World monkeys.
Ears are small and partially obscured by the facial ruff, matching the anatomical expectation.
